knownLimits: CLI and Bot remain independent model contexts; only the project worktree is shared.
Native recovery is limited to admitted OpenCode 1.18.29/1.19.0 capability contracts; missing legacy HOME cannot be recovered from chat rendering.
Explicit fresh advances the epoch and preserves displayed history, while deliberately starting a different native context.
Releasing a follow-container parent recycles its private context volume; this is not the Stop current turn action.
The real sleep interruption used observed live process evidence; the native JSON protocol did not emit tool-start before command completion.
The full local gate was not green. Focused environment comparisons do not replace its failure; hosted CI is recorded separately.
